subject_identity_derivation.why: RNB-2: the V1 closure missed a runtime-loaded corpus and the test toolchain that executes the certified tests. V2 adds exactly those two classes, derived by fixed rules, and nothing else: it is not the whole repository.
steps: S1 C must name a COMMIT object; tree_sha = C^{tree}; tree_sha never equals candidate_sha.
S2 COVERED = every path of the tree of C starting with a covered_path_prefix of the kind, byte-sorted, non-empty.

S3 IMPORTED = transitive closure of repository imports from COVERED code files (.ts .tsx .js .mjs .cjs): import_specifier_grammar matches whose specifier starts with "." (relative to the importing file) or "@/" (repository root), resolved with import_resolution_suffixes in order; an unresolvable specifier of either form fails the derivation; package specifiers are not followed.

S4 TOOLCHAIN = the kind's toolchain_roots (each must exist at C), plus every path listed in a setupFiles array literal of a toolchain root code file (resolved relative to that root; must exist), plus the transitive repository-import closure (S3 grammar) of those files, minus paths already assigned.

S5 RUNTIME_INPUT = every string literal of runtime_literal_grammar found in a COVERED code file with comments removed (block comments and line comments not preceded by ":" or "\\"), resolved relative to the file when it starts with "./" or "../" and to the repository root otherwise, that names an existing file at C not already assigned and not matching docs/ops/**.json. Literals that name no file are ignored (they are output paths, globs or identifiers). RUNTIME_INPUT files are not scanned further.
S6 GOVERNING = every distinct match of docs/ops/[A-Za-z0-9_./-]+\.json in the text of any COVERED, TOOLCHAIN or IMPORTED path, not already assigned; every GOVERNING path must exist at C.
S7 entries = COVERED, TOOLCHAIN, IMPORTED, RUNTIME_INPUT, GOVERNING, each byte-sorted by path, as {role, path, blob}.
S8 package_digest = lowercase hex sha256 over the UTF-8 concatenation of role TAB path TAB blob LF for each entry in order.
S9 governing_families and governing_family_members_at_candidate ({path, blob}) as v1.0.3 S7/S8.
subject_identity_derivation.runtime_literal_grammar: a single-, double- or back-quoted literal of the form (./|../)?SEG(/SEG)+.EXT where SEG is [A-Za-z0-9_.@-]+ (the first segment not starting with "." unless it is "." or "..") and EXT is [A-Za-z0-9]+; no "*", no whitespace, no scheme.
subject_identity_derivation.v1_equivalence: For a kind with no code files and no toolchain roots (READONLY_CENSUS_AUTHORITY_RECERT) V2 produces the same entries and the same package_digest as V1.

verdict.non_positive_rule: NON_POSITIVE = every verdict_class not in positive_classes (owner v1.0.2: FAIL, BLOCKED, INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE and any other non-PASS class). PASS_WITH_NONBLOCKING_FINDINGS is POSITIVE by v1.0.3 SECTION_D9.verdict.PASS_CLASS, which this artifact carries; the owner text does not reach it. The two lists partition verdict_classes exactly.

literal_rule.positive: A record whose verdict_class is POSITIVE must carry a literal that parses STRICTLY to that class: split on "_", the class is the longest verdict_class forming a proper suffix of the tokens, the prefix is non-empty, its LAST token is one of required_qualifier_tokens and EVERY prefix token is in the CLOSED prefix_token_vocabulary or matches version_token_pattern. Anything else STOPS (STOP_VERDICT_LITERAL_MISMATCH). A negation, qualifier or unknown word can therefore never produce a positive record.
literal_rule.non_positive: A record whose verdict_class is NON-POSITIVE carries the adjudicator literal VERBATIM as opaque evidence: a non-empty ASCII [A-Z0-9_]+ string whose tokens do NOT END with the tokens of any positive class (strictly parseable or not), so a genuine PASS verdict can never be recorded as non-positive. The vocabulary does NOT restrict non-positive literals (review finding B2: restricting them made real FAIL verdicts unrecordable, which kept a PASS usable). A positive-parsing literal on a non-positive record STOPS (STOP_VERDICT_LITERAL_MISMATCH). The materializer maps a literal outside the closed classes (for example ..._PASS_WITH_PROGRAM_BLOCKERS) to the non-positive class the adjudicator report states; never to a positive class.
literal_rule.removed: v1.0.3 forbidden_prefix_tokens is not carried: with a closed vocabulary disjoint from it, it was dead code. REVIEW is not a qualifier and not in the vocabulary.

provenance.lane_id_grammar: ^[A-Z0-9]+(-[A-Z0-9]+)*$ (ASCII upper-case letters, digits and single hyphens; no Unicode, no whitespace, no other separator). Anything else STOPS (STOP_PROVENANCE_IDENTITY_MALFORMED).
provenance.identity_key: lane_id with every "-" removed. The three identity keys must be pairwise distinct (STOP_PROVENANCE_NOT_INDEPENDENT). This defeats case, whitespace, separator and Unicode-confusable variants of one lane id; it does not and cannot prove that three distinct ids are three distinct actors.
provenance.independence_basis: PROCESS_GOVERNED: independence is established by the governed lane process (separate lane briefs, separate sessions, recorded in the report reference), not by cryptographic identity. The field is required with exactly this value; no identity or authentication infrastructure is authorized or implied.

recert_scope.scope_basis_rule: FULL_SUBJECT has an empty scope_basis. Every other scope has a non-empty scope_basis: a list of non-empty strings naming the prior independent adjudication rounds (report references) whose coverage the bounded or focused adjudication relies on. Anything else STOPS (STOP_RECERT_SCOPE_UNDECLARED).

provenance.adjudicator_subject_binding: independent_adjudicator.examined_candidate_sha and examined_tree_sha equal subject.candidate_sha and subject.tree_sha (STOP_RECERT_SUBJECT_MISMATCH). Candidate and tree are EVIDENCE of what was examined; revocation and currency are bound to package_digest.

path_and_identity.path_length_rule: KIND_CODE is the closed per-kind code of kind_path_codes, used instead of the kind name so that the repository-relative path stays at most 170 characters (Windows MAX_PATH hazard, CLAUDE.md section 9); the full kind is inside the record. Both digests stay full-length sha256.
path_and_identity.adjudication_digest: lowercase hex sha256 over the canonical JSON of the parsed record (object keys sorted recursively by code point, no insignificant whitespace, UTF-8). The file is content-addressed: its path names the digest of its own content, so two different adjudications never share a path and any edit breaks the path identity.

store_integrity.rule: EVERY git entry under adjudication_root at H is a candidate record, whatever it claims to be. The store is VALID only if every entry: (1) is a regular file (mode 100644; no symlink, gitlink/submodule or executable); (2) has the path shape adjudication_root/KIND_CODE/<64 hex>/<64 hex>.json with KIND_CODE in kind_path_codes; (3) parses as JSON and its bytes are EXACTLY the canonical pretty serialization of the parsed value (object keys sorted recursively by code point, two-space indentation, LF line ends, one trailing LF), so duplicate keys, reordered keys or reformatting are rejected; (4) has a subject_kind in the closed enum whose kind_path_codes entry equals the KIND_CODE directory; (5) has subject.package_digest equal to its directory digest and adjudication_digest equal to its filename. Membership of a kind is decided by the DIRECTORY and must agree with the record.
store_integrity.stop: STOP_ADJUDICATION_STORE_INVALID for EVERY kind (root-wide): a record that cannot be attributed can never be silently ignored (review finding B1: a FAIL with a mistyped or foreign subject_kind was skipped and the PASS stayed usable).
store_integrity.repair: None by this contract: entries are write-once. Only a later independently certified amendment with an owner record may define a repair (for example a quarantine list); until then the store STOPS.

SECTION_E3_ADJUDICATION_CONTRACT.canonical_serialization: File bytes = canonical pretty serialization (store_integrity (3)); adjudication_digest = sha256 of the canonical COMPACT serialization of the same parsed value.

chain.rule: All adjudications of one subject_kind, of every verdict class, form ONE chain. chain.predecessor is null for the first adjudication of the kind, otherwise {path, adjudication_digest} of the chain TIP at write time.
chain.read_time_integrity: At read time, for each kind: exactly one record has predecessor null (single root); every predecessor reference names a record that EXISTS at H under the adjudication root whose recomputed adjudication_digest equals the reference; exactly one tip; every record reachable from the tip by predecessor links (no orphan, no fork, no cycle). Any violation makes every adjudication of that kind unusable (STOP_CHAIN_INTEGRITY_VIOLATED).
chain.order: Chain position (distance from the root) is the ONLY ordering of adjudications. No timestamp, filename, author assertion or date field orders them.

write_once_history.rule: Every path under the adjudication root is write-once in the FULL git DAG history of the consumer head H.
write_once_history.preconditions: git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository prints false (a shallow clone hides history: STOP_ADJUDICATION_HISTORY_UNVERIFIABLE). The command runs with GIT_NO_REPLACE_OBJECTS=1, --no-replace-objects, GIT_GRAFT_FILE pointing to a non-existent file, and -c log.showRoot=true, so replace refs, grafts and a local log.showRoot=false cannot rewrite or hide history.
write_once_history.why_full_history: Default history simplification follows one TREESAME parent through a merge and hides a competing add on the other side (RB-2, add/add merge). --full-history lists every commit that touched the path on every branch; --no-renames reports a rename as a DELETE plus an ADD; --cc reports a merge entry only where the merge result differs from ALL parents (an evil merge).
write_once_history.per_path: EVERY path present under the root at H has exactly ONE ADD entry in a non-merge commit (zero or one parent; a root commit counts as non-merge); ZERO modify, delete, type-change or copy entries; ZERO merge (combined) entries. A path present at H with zero ADD entries is a violation.
write_once_history.root_wide: ZERO delete entries anywhere under the root (so a deleted predecessor or a deleted tip, i.e. a truncation or restart, is visible even when every surviving path looks clean).
write_once_history.stop: STOP_ADJUDICATION_HISTORY_VIOLATED ROOT-WIDE: a violation anywhere under the adjudication root makes every kind unusable (the safe direction; v1.0.4 draft text said per kind).
write_once_history.proven_against: real git DAG fixtures in the companion test: plain add, add/add merge, delete, delete and re-add, modify, rename, evil merge, legitimate side-branch add merged normally, shallow clone, replace-graft evasion, log.showRoot=false evasion, gitlink entry.

canonical_store.transitional: The branch that carries this contract. A materializer lane opens its pull request against this ref. The ref is moved only by a later independently certified amendment (for example when the Recovery chain is merged into integration/commercial-v1); a deleted or renamed canonical ref makes every consumer STOP until then.
canonical_store.freshness_rule: A consumer at head H fetches CANONICAL_ADJUDICATION_REF immediately before evaluation and requires BOTH (a) the fetched tip is an ANCESTOR of H (git merge-base --is-ancestor <tip> H), so that the canonical history, including any deletion on it, is inside the history write_once_history inspects at H; and (b) every entry under adjudication_root at the fetched tip is present at H with the same blob (implied by (a) together with write_once_history at H; kept as a direct diagnostic). Otherwise STOP_ADJUDICATION_STORE_STALE. (a) closes the gap a pre-commit review found in containment alone: a FAIL added and then deleted on the canonical ref leaves a tip that an older head still contains.
canonical_store.evidence: The consumer records the fetched tip SHA and the containment result.

validation.write_time: W1..W11 of validation_order at the materializer head.
validation.read_time: W1..W10 at the consumer head H (W3 compares adjudication_contract.blob with the blob of this artifact at H), plus R1 write_once_history and R2 chain.read_time_integrity. W11 is write-time only.

disposition_status.rule: For a subject_kind and a package_digest P, let D(P) be the adjudications of that kind whose subject.package_digest = P, in chain order. Evaluated only when the kind passed read-time validation.

statuses.NEGATIVELY_ADJUDICATED: D(P) contains only non-positive adjudications. Not usable (STOP_NOT_CERTIFIED).
statuses.REVOKED: D(P) contains a positive adjudication and a LATER non-positive adjudication, and no positive adjudication follows the first non-positive one. Not usable (STOP_CERTIFICATION_REVOKED). Every positive adjudication for P is revoked regardless of its candidate SHA (owner v1.0.2).
statuses.CONTRADICTED: D(P) contains a positive adjudication that FOLLOWS a non-positive adjudication. Not usable (STOP_CONTRADICTORY_CERTIFICATION). A later PASS never erases an earlier non-positive adjudication; no latest-wins, no filename or timestamp ordering, no silent reactivation.

disposition_status.recovery_from_revoked_or_contradicted: Only (1) a materially new package_digest independently adjudicated positive, or (2) a future owner adjudication made mechanical by a later certified amendment (owner v1.0.2). Neither is performed here.

currency.rule: A CERTIFIED closure P is CURRENT at H when the V2 closure derived at H has package_digest P (so every COVERED, TOOLCHAIN, IMPORTED, RUNTIME_INPUT and GOVERNING blob is unchanged) and the governing-family rule of v1.0.3 SECTION_D9.currency (6) holds against the latest positive adjudication for P, with the declared layers below. SUBJECT_NOT_PRESENT when COVERED at H is empty. Otherwise STALE.

consumer_rule.rule: A positive certification is USABLE by a consumer at head H only when it is CURRENT AND NOT_REVOKED AND NOT_CONTRADICTED (owner brief). Mechanically, for a subject_kind K at H, in order: (0) H is not a shallow clone (STOP_ADJUDICATION_HISTORY_UNVERIFIABLE); (1) no file exists under the retired occurrence root (STOP_RETIRED_OCCURRENCE_ROOT_USED); (2) store_integrity holds for the WHOLE root (STOP_ADJUDICATION_STORE_INVALID); (3) write_once_history holds for the whole root (STOP_ADJUDICATION_HISTORY_VIOLATED); (4) chain.read_time_integrity holds for K (STOP_CHAIN_INTEGRITY_VIOLATED); (5) every adjudication of EVERY kind passes read-time validation (STOP_ADJUDICATION_INVALID_AT_READ); (6) canonical_store.freshness_rule holds (STOP_ADJUDICATION_STORE_STALE); (7) the V2 closure of K at H exists (STOP_SUBJECT_NOT_PRESENT) with digest P; (8) disposition_status(K, P) is CERTIFIED (else its stop code); (9) currency is CURRENT against the LATEST positive adjudication for P (STOP_NOT_CURRENT). The result carries {usable, status, package_digest, scopes, scope_basis, canonical_tip}.
consumer_rule.scope: The consumer result reports the scope of every positive adjudication for P and its scope_basis; a consumer that requires FULL_SUBJECT says so in its own authority. No consumer in this chain requires more than the scopes the owner accepted in practice (OF-RV-3).

W7 identity equals the V2 re-derivation at the candidate and, for a known subject, SECTION_E5 (entries, families and members compared in both cases): candidate and a distinct tree (STOP_CANDIDATE_SHA_MISMATCH), tree (STOP_TREE_SHA_MISMATCH), COVERED/TOOLCHAIN/IMPORTED/RUNTIME_INPUT lists and blobs (STOP_COVERED_SET_MISMATCH), GOVERNING, families and members (STOP_GOVERNING_PIN_MISMATCH), package_digest (STOP_PACKAGE_DIGEST_MISMATCH).
W8 literal_rule for the record class (STOP_VERDICT_LITERAL_MISMATCH); class consistency (STOP_VERDICT_CLASS_INCONSISTENT).

W10 lane-id grammar (STOP_PROVENANCE_IDENTITY_MALFORMED), independence (STOP_PROVENANCE_NOT_INDEPENDENT), adjudicator binding (STOP_RECERT_SUBJECT_MISMATCH), scope and basis (STOP_RECERT_SCOPE_UNDECLARED), bases and PROCESS_GOVERNED (STOP_MATERIALIZER_REPRODUCTION_CLAIM).

W11 WRITE-TIME ONLY: path free (STOP_ADJUDICATION_PATH_EXISTS); predecessor is the tip with its digest, or null when the kind has none (STOP_CHAIN_PREDECESSOR_MISMATCH); closes_predecessor_findings valid (STOP_FINDING_CLOSURE_INVALID).
R1 READ-TIME ONLY: write_once_history (STOP_ADJUDICATION_HISTORY_VIOLATED). R2 READ-TIME ONLY: chain.read_time_integrity (STOP_CHAIN_INTEGRITY_VIOLATED).

The Docker images the offline primitives use are pinned by image id inside COVERED code.
